definitions.explanation: Surgical procedures performed to improve one's appearance, as opposed to reconstructive surgery performed for medical necessity.

examples.japanese: {美容整形|びようせいけい}を{受|う}ける。
{美容整形|びようせいけい}に{興味|きょうみ}がある{若者|わかもの}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More and more young people are interested in cosmetic surgery.

examples.japanese: {美容整形|びようせいけい}にはリスクもあるので、{慎重|しんちょう}に{検討|けんとう}すべきだ。
examples.english: There are risks to cosmetic surgery, so it should be considered carefully.

notes:
Composed of {美容|びよう} (beauty, cosmetic) + {整形|せいけい} (reshaping, plastic surgery). Often shortened to just {整形|せいけい} in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美容整形|びようせいけい}を{受|う}ける: to have cosmetic surgery
- {美容整形|びようせいけい}{外科|げか}: cosmetic surgery clinic
- {美容整形|びようせいけい}{手術|しゅじゅつ}: cosmetic surgery operation
- プチ{整形|せいけい}: minor cosmetic procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {整形|せいけい}: plastic surgery — the abbreviated form; can also mean orthopedic surgery in medical contexts ({整形外科|せいけいげか})
- {形成外科|けいせいげか}: reconstructive surgery — surgery to restore function or normal appearance after injury or birth defects
- {美容外科|びようげか}: cosmetic surgery department — the medical specialty name
